Join ChuChu, ChaCha, Chika, Chiku, and Cussly as they dive into one of history’s greatest unsolved mysteries: The Nazca Lines!
In this episode, Mr. Charlie takes the kids on a virtual trip to Peru to see giant designs etched into the ground—from massive monkeys and spiders to hummingbirds and perfect geometric shapes.
In this video, you’ll discover:
• Where the Nazca Lines are located.
• How the ancient Paracas and Nazca cultures created them by removing dark rocks from light sand.
• Why experts think they were built—was it for stars, calendars, or rain rituals?.
